description: SHOW THE TEMPLATE GALLERY as a picture: one image with up to 12 templates in a 3-column grid, each drawn with its example values and numbered, with its name and slug under it, plus items[] in the same order. Use it whenever the person wants to see the templates, pick one or decide which to copy: show the image, never a table. Same filters as viralhunt_list_templates; page through with page (has_more). A template not drawn yet shows a neutral tile: it is drawn the first time someone in the organization opens the Templates page. Read only.

assigned.description: true = only the templates assigned to project_id.

favorites.description: true = only the templates the brand starred.

project_id.description: With assigned=true, the project whose allowed templates you want.

scope.description: org = only the organization's own templates, global = only the library.

name: viralhunt_template_gallery
